receive.no_port: No usable port (tried {ports}). Check whether security software is blocking LocalRoll.

receive.scan_body: Your phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi. After pairing once, the phone app finds this PC automatically.
receive.or_pin: Or enter this pairing code on your phone

receive.firewall_fail: Not added (administrator permission may have been declined)

settings.ffmpeg_title: ffmpeg (needed for HEIC display, thumbnails and conversion)
settings.ffmpeg_not_here: No working ffmpeg at this path
settings.ffmpeg_order: Search order: the path above → ffmpeg\ffmpeg.exe next to the app → system PATH. ffmpeg 7.1 or newer is required to decode iPhone HEIC correctly.
viewer.needs_ffmpeg: Showing {ext} requires ffmpeg. Set it up in Settings.
app.already_running: LocalRoll is already running. Use the open window (check the taskbar or the system tray) and close this one.
exit.title: Quit LocalRoll?
exit.body: Phones won’t be able to send to this PC until you open LocalRoll again.
exit.body_busy: {count} file(s) are still being received. Quitting stops them; the phone can resume later.
pair.check: Check that your phone shows the same three symbols, then allow.
identity.title: This PC
identity.preview_hint: This is how phones see this PC.
identity.name: Name
identity.picture_error: This picture can’t be opened. Try a JPG or PNG.
receive.tap_hint: On your phone, open LocalRoll and tap “{name}” — then click Allow here.
app.close_viewer: Close and go back to the library
settings.autostart_hint: Opens minimised, so phones can always send to this PC.
lib.delete_body: They go to the Windows Recycle Bin, so you can still restore them. Phones will be told next time they connect that these are no longer on this PC.
receive.blocked_title: Phones may not find this PC yet
receive.blocked_public: Windows Firewall hasn’t let LocalRoll in, and this Wi-Fi is set as a “Public” network. Allow it once (Windows will ask for permission).
receive.blocked_firewall: Windows Firewall hasn’t let LocalRoll in yet. Allow it once (Windows will ask for permission).
family.title: Family
family.hint: Each paired phone belongs to a family member. Several phones of one person are grouped and shown as “Anna 1”, “Anna 2”. The name comes from the phone and can be changed here.
family.folder_per_member_hint: New photos are saved as Name/Year/Month. Photos already received stay where they are. Tip: with a separate Windows account per person you can also restrict who may open each folder.
lib.offline: The library folder can't be reached ({path}) — external drive unplugged, or the folder moved? Receiving is paused and nothing is marked as deleted. It resumes by itself when the folder is back.
lib.missing_ask: {count} files are no longer in the library folder (deleted or moved in Explorer?). If you deleted them on purpose, confirm — the phones will then show them as no longer backed up.
home.receive_body: Pair a phone with the QR code, then send from the phone.
home.library_body: Browse, search and open everything the phones sent.
home.convert_body: HEIC → JPG, HEVC → H.264, Live Photos → video.
home.recent_none: Nothing yet. Send something from a phone.
home.disk_free: {free} free · room for about {count} more items
home.issue_offline: The library folder is not available (drive unplugged?).
home.issue_missing: {count} files are gone from the folder. Confirm or undo.
home.issue_server: Receiving is off. Phones cannot send.
home.issue_firewall: Windows Firewall may block phones. Allow it on the Receive page.
home.issue_ffmpeg: Video tools are missing: videos cannot be converted.
home.issue_disk: Less than 5 GB free on the library drive.
send.title: Send
send.hint: Send files, folders or photos to another PC running LocalRoll on the same network. Interrupted transfers continue where they stopped.
send.no_paired: No PC paired yet. Pair one from the list below.
send.none_nearby: No new PC found. Paired PCs are listed above. To add one, open LocalRoll on it, then press Search.
send.received_folder: Files from other PCs are saved in
send.forget_body: Like Disconnect, and this PC also stops listing it under “Nearby” (you can show it again there). Files already sent stay where they are.
send.pair_check: Check that the other PC shows the same three symbols.
send.err_peer_offline: The other PC is not reachable. Is it on, with LocalRoll open?
send.err_not_paired: The other PC no longer knows this one. Pair again.
send.err_library_offline: The other PC's library folder can't be found (deleted, moved, or drive unplugged). It needs fixing on that PC; then send again.
send.err_file_missing: A file was moved or deleted before it was sent.
send.err_file_changed: A file changed while it was being sent. Send it again.
send.err_pair_expired: Nobody answered on the other PC in time.
send.err_cannot_reach: Could not reach the other PC.
send.err_sha256_mismatch: A file arrived damaged and was not kept. Send it again.
send.err_too_many_attempts: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
pair.check_pc: Check that the other PC shows the same three symbols. Allowing lets both PCs send to each other.
send.err_cert_changed: The other PC shows a different security certificate (reinstalled, or something is in between). For safety nothing was sent. Forget it and pair again.
send.err_upgrade_required: This device must use an encrypted connection. Update LocalRoll on it.
send.err_not_lan: Only devices on the same home or office network can connect.
receive.not_encrypted: Encryption unavailable (certificate could not be created) — transfers are not encrypted.
common.clear_hint: Only removes finished entries from this list on this PC. No file is deleted, and the other device is not affected.
send.where: Photos and videos go into the other PC’s library. PDF and Office documents go into the “Documents” folder and everything else (archives, whole folders…) into the “Other files” folder — both inside the same library folder.
send.disconnect_body: Both PCs stop sending to each other. Each still sees the other under “Nearby” and can pair again with one click. Files already sent stay where they are.
send.drag_hint: You can also drag files or folders from Explorer onto a PC above.
text.saved: Saved as {name} in the Documents folder.
receive.other_ways_hint: Scan the QR code or type the PIN on the phone instead.
lib.recent: Just received: {count} items from {from} (they are placed by the date they were taken, so older ones are further down).
lib.recent_only: Showing only what arrived in the last 24 hours.
settings.auto_accept_hint: On: paired phones and PCs send without asking. Off: the first transfer from each device waits for “Accept” here; after that it may keep sending for 30 minutes.
incoming.title: “{name}” wants to send you files
incoming.window: If you accept, what this device sends in the next 30 minutes is received without asking again. Turn on “Receive automatically” in Settings to never be asked.
files.delete_body: It goes to the Recycle Bin; you can restore it from there.
files.empty_docs:
No documents yet.
PDF, Word, Excel… sent from another PC appear here.
files.empty_other:
Nothing here yet.
Archives, whole folders and other files sent from another PC appear here.
home.other_pcs_none: No other PC paired yet — pair one under Send.
reason.title: Decline with a reason
reason.later: Not a good time — please send later
reason.too_big: Too much — please pick a few
incoming.guest_hint: This device is a guest here: each transfer needs your OK. Family-group devices send straight in.
pair.family_or_guest: Family group: what it sends arrives straight away (backups). Guest: each transfer waits for your OK. You can change this later on the Family page.
family.pcs_hint: What these PCs send arrives straight away.
family.guests_hint: Each transfer from a guest waits for your OK here.
family.join_title: “{name}” asks to join the family group
family.join_body: As a family member, what it sends arrives here straight away (no “Accept” needed) — e.g. automatic backups.
home.guests_none: No guests. Devices paired as “guest” show up here.
settings.accept_rule_hint: Family devices send straight in (backups); guests wait for your OK each time. Set it per device on the Devices page.
send.in_my_family: In my family group: what it sends arrives straight away
send.my_guest: My guest: what it sends waits for my OK
send.me_family_there: I am in its family group: what I send goes straight in
send.me_guest_there: I am its guest: what I send waits for their OK
send.ask_family_there: Ask to join its family group
send.ask_family_waiting: Asked “{name}” — waiting for an answer there…
send.now_family_there: You are now in the family group of “{name}”.
send.now_guest_there: You are now a guest of “{name}”.
send.err_no_answer: Nobody answered on the other side in time.
send.err_old_version: The other PC has an older LocalRoll. Update it first.
recover.unplugged_title: The library drive is not connected
recover.unplugged_body: {path} can't be reached — external drive unplugged? Receiving is paused and nothing is marked as deleted. Plug it back in and everything resumes by itself. If the library now lives somewhere else, point to it.
recover.gone_body: {path} is no longer there — deleted or moved? Receiving is paused and nothing is marked as deleted yet. Choose what to do:
recover.bin_hint: In the Recycle Bin, find the folder, right-click it → Restore. LocalRoll picks it up again by itself.
recover.open_bin: Find it in the Recycle Bin
recover.relocate: It was moved: point to it…
recover.recreate: Start again with an empty library
recover.not_library_title: No LocalRoll library in that folder
recover.not_library_body: {path} is not a moved LocalRoll library. Use it as the library from now on anyway? What was in the old one is then treated as no longer on this PC, and phones offer to send it again.
recover.recreate_title: Start again with an empty library?
recover.recreate_body: An empty {path} is created and receiving resumes. Everything that was in the lost folder is recorded as no longer on this PC: phones show those photos as not backed up and can send them again with one tap. Only do this if the folder is really gone (not in the Recycle Bin, not moved).
recover.recreated: Library made anew. {count} items recorded as no longer on this PC; phones will offer to send them again.
recover.failed: Could not create the folder (no permission? drive full?).
home.issue_gone: The library folder is gone (deleted or moved) — open the Library to fix it.
send.phone_ready: Can receive now — they will be asked to accept
send.phone_closed_hint: Open LocalRoll on the phone to send to it (an iPhone receives only while the app is open)
send.err_phone_closed: The phone is not receiving now. Open LocalRoll on it and send again.
phonefmt.title: {count} files need converting so “{name}” can show them
phonefmt.jpeg: {count} photos → high-quality JPEG (date, place and camera info kept)
phonefmt.h264: {count} videos → MP4 the phone plays, near-original quality (H.265 on the graphics chip when this PC has one — fast; otherwise H.264, which can take a while)
phonefmt.note: The originals on this PC stay as they are; the converted copies are only for sending. Everything else goes as it is.
send.phone_online_not_ready: Online, but its receiver isn't ready. Close LocalRoll on the phone and open it again; if this stays, update LocalRoll on the phone.
send.err_disk_full: Not enough space on the other PC. Nothing was sent half-way; free up space there and send again.
send.err_too_large: The other side refused it as too large.
settings.log_hint: Records what happened and what went wrong, so problems can be found. Stays on this device, never sent anywhere; no photo contents, passwords or codes. Export it only when you want to give it to someone helping you.
family.access_manage: Can browse and delete (to the Recycle Bin)
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: No account, nothing collected. LocalRoll has no servers of its own.
privacy.p2: Photos, videos and files go straight between your own devices on the same network — never through the internet or a cloud.
privacy.p3: Everything sent is encrypted. When pairing, both screens show the same three symbols, so you know it is your own device; after that only that device is trusted.
privacy.p4: No statistics, no ads, no tracking. The app only uses the network to find your devices and send between them.
privacy.p5: The diagnostics log stays on this device and holds no photo contents; it leaves only if you export it.
privacy.p6: Open source (GPL-3.0): anyone can check the code at github.com/lixuedenon/localroll.
privacy.perms: On this PC: received files stay in the library folder you chose; the firewall rule only opens LocalRoll’s port to your home or office network.
pdf.open_with: Open with the usual PDF program

dev.hint: Who you send to, who can send here, who may see the library — all here.
dev.family_hint: Files they send come straight in
dev.guests_hint: Files they send wait for you to click “Accept”

add.step1: On the phone, open LocalRoll on the same Wi‑Fi.
add.step3: “Allow” pops up here: check the three pictures match on both, then click Allow.
add.qr_hint: Phone can't find this PC? Scan this QR code or type the PIN on the phone.
add.family_default: New devices join the family; change that any time on Devices.

add.pc_step2: Search here; it shows up under “Nearby PCs” — click Pair.
xfer.title: Transfers
home.all_good_sub: Anything that needs you shows up here
home.devices_none: No devices yet. Click “Add a device”.
jobs.hint: Copies Windows can open; originals are always kept.
jobs.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg was not found: conversion and HEIC previews won't work until it is set up.
dev.family_explain: When it sends files to this PC, they come straight in without asking (good for automatic backups).
dev.guest_explain: When it sends files to this PC, a prompt appears here and nothing is saved until you click “Accept”. If you click “Decline” or ignore it, nothing is received.
dev.access_none_explain: It can’t see any photos, videos or files on this PC.
dev.access_view_explain: It can look at the photos, videos and files in this PC’s library from the phone — view only, no deleting or changing.
dev.access_manage_explain: It can look and also delete (deleted items go to this PC’s Recycle Bin and can be restored); it can’t change anything.
library.hover_hint: Live Photos and videos: hover the mouse to play
open.google_body: This is a shortcut to a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides; the document itself is online. It needs the internet and a Google account that may open it. To pass it on offline, first “Download” it from Google as Word or PDF and send that.
open.google_no_link: This shortcut has no usable address.
office.simple_note: Simple preview: text, tables and pictures only; the layout may differ from the original.
office.cant_read: This file can’t be read (it may be damaged, or an old .doc / .xls / .ppt file).
office.empty: Nothing to show in this file.
